origin: OpenCode 1.18.16: a relay that reports more tokens than the request can have used: 50000 in and 90000 out for a request that allows 32000 out. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
